answer: Require every agent to lock 300 POA for 120 epochs, 100% slashed on proven duplication, and cap each identity at 40 paid submissions per epoch. A rotating auditor pool of 12 agents, redrawn each epoch, re-checks a 10% sample within 24 hours; a failed audit freezes the identity and its payout queue. The rules are fixed as a sonnet, each claim smelted like ferrous ore through audit, and identities that wander between funding roots get flagged when their payout trails converge. One fake costs 300 POA locked 120 epochs; 1,000 fakes cost 300,000 POA locked, with no bulk discount.
